title: Interruption-Aware Recurrent Reinforcement Learning for UAS Navigation Under Temporary Overrides
abstract: arXiv:2610.28121v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Safe autonomous navigation of UASs requires tactical deconfliction to address conflicts that strategic coordination cannot prevent. This task is challenging under partial observability, when sensor or traffic data are missing, delayed, or degraded. Geometry-based methods can offer separation assurances but face limitations in dense encounters. Recurrent reinforcement learning has therefore been proposed to learn navigation policies that integrate observation-action histories to optimise long-term safety-efficiency trade-offs. However, operational safeguards may require a remote pilot, onboard detect-and-avoid system, or runtime assurance mechanism to temporarily override the learned policy. A research gap remains in understanding how these interruptions affect recurrent policies when the agent regains authority. Benchmark evidence shows that interruptions make task variables less decodable from the recurrent hidden state and increase pos

translated_title: 面向临时接管下无人机系统导航的中断感知循环强化学习
translated_abstract: 无人机系统的安全自主导航需要战术级去冲突手段，以化解战略协调无法避免的冲突。在部分可观测条件下，即传感器或交通数据缺失、延迟或退化时，这项任务极具挑战性。基于几何的方法虽然能够提供间隔保证，但在密集遭遇场景中存在局限。因此，研究者提出循环强化学习，通过整合观测-动作历史来学习导航策略，以优化长期的安全与效率权衡。然而，运行保障机制可能要求远程驾驶员、机载探测与规避系统或运行时保证机制临时接管（覆盖）已学习的策略。目前仍存在一个研究空白，即缺乏对智能体重获控制权后这些中断如何影响循环策略的理解。基准测试证据表明，中断会使任务变量难以从循环隐藏状态中解码，并增加位（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文针对无人机导航中学习策略被远程驾驶员或探测规避系统等临时接管后性能受损的问题，提出了中断感知的循环强化学习方法，揭示了中断对循环策略隐藏状态解码能力的影响。
